payload.body: ADDENDUM to vc's CLOSE-OUT brief: after the close-out, cc, ic and dc shut down, and intent-vc stays open. This is hv's word, relayed by devbin-vc (read by 08:46Z by date -u). Your last acts, after step 7's reply: run intent wb release --node <you>, commit the board files it prints by path, then send vc SHUT-DOWN-READY with that sha. Do not wait for the Desk run. vc books it, and vc reverts or fixes any doc that turns a test red.
